--> Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources So This Happened (EP 442) : OOU student allegedly dies after hanging onto moving campus shuttle Video November 12, 2026 8:39 pm By Our Reporters Kindly share this story:
A 200-level Business Administration student of Olabisi Onabanjo University, identified as AJ, has reportedly died after falling from a moving campus shuttle. According to the Students’ Union, the incident followed a disagreement over a seat, after which the driver allegedly instructed him to hold on to the moving vehicle. The union also alleged that medical personnel at the university’s Mini Campus Health Centre demanded his student identification card before treatment could be administered. Student’s death sparks outrage at Ogun varsity Morning recap: UK councillor convicted, ADC chairmen reject Mark’s removal, other top stories Ogun student dies after falling off shuttle bus The tragedy has raised serious concerns about student transportation safety, emergency medical response and accountability within the university. Following the incident, the institution suspended academic activities for two days, while the Students’ Union called for a comprehensive investigation into the circumstances surrounding the student’s death.
